backend: GET /api/svc/engineer/notifications - returns notifications sorted by created_at desc
POST /api/svc/engineer/notifications/{id}/read - marks single notification as read
POST /api/svc/engineer/notifications/read-all - marks all notifications as read
POST /api/svc/engineer/push/subscribe - stores subscription doc keyed by endpoint hash
POST /api/svc/admin/diary/case/{id}/assign - auto-creates job_assigned notification for engineer
frontend: Push subscribe panel with 'Enable push notifications' button (data-testid='push-subscribe')
Filter chips: notif-filter-all, notif-filter-unread - both clickable
Mark-read button (notif-mark-read-{id}) - visible for unread notifications
Delete button (notif-delete-{id}) - visible for all notifications
Mark all read button (notif-mark-all-read) - visible when unread count > 0
Bell badge on EngineerHomeV2 (engineer-home-notifications-btn) - navigates to notifications

web_push_notes: Web Push end-to-end (real push delivery) is NOT testable in CI without browser permission grant. Tested: subscribe endpoint stores subscription, VAPID key endpoint returns persisted key, test push endpoint creates notification doc.
